findings: Four distinct contact/passing drawings replace the inherited same-leading-leg silhouette, but near/far leg ownership still needs explicit review.
Passing knees and boots lift too high for the intended relaxed walking gait.
Current shared-scale lower-leg pivot normalization shifts the upper-body alpha centroid about 14.8 native pixels between contact and passing poses.
Torso and head consistency require anatomical landmark review before any registration change; do not force head centroids or warp paint.
